Priya Nair: quick question - should new SA tokens be billed to their creating project by default? we've got messy cross-project chargebacks.
Alex Kim: yes, default to creator/origin project. simplifies quotas and billing.
Jordan Lee: ok for billing, but cross-project jobs need exchange. propose claims: origin_project (immutable) + current_project (exchange-only). billing defaults to origin unless exchange includes explicit `charge_to_target` flag.
Maya (design): UI requirement: when someone opts to charge target project, show a clear confirm modal with cost estimate and a one-click confirm. also show a small banner on token list when origin != current.
Priya Nair: telemetry plan: emit `auth.exchange` events with token_id, origin_project, current_project, actor, route. use that feed to validate real-world impacts during canary.
SRE-Bot: recommended event schema: ["token_id","origin_project","current_project","actor","exchange_ms","route","node_id"]. keep payload minimal.
Alex Kim: implementation note: do exchange at auth-proxy, return short-lived impersonation JWT; avoid DB writes by keeping origin immutable in token metadata and putting current_project in token claims. prefer `X-Forwarded-Actor` header for downstream services.
Jordan Lee: migration: detect existing tokens used cross-project -> mark as legacy-floating and keep old behavior; new tokens follow origin-lock. rollout: 2 weeks telemetry only, then 30-day billing canary (charge origin), then flip new token policy + migration tool.
Priya Nair: action items: Alex draft API flag + response shape; Jordan document claim format; Maya mock UI confirm; SRE-Bot publish event schema. I'll schedule a 30-min review.
